step_by_step_reasoning: The visual whiteboard architecture illustrates an image feature extraction pipeline for luxury goods. The entry point is AWS Amplify connected to API Gateway for frontend interaction, with API Gateway interacting with Cognito for authentication. API Gateway uploads media to S3. S3 triggers a Lambda function via data event, which invokes Amazon Rekognition for image/feature identification, passing down to Amazon Textract for text extraction. DynamoDB is present as a standalone node on the diagram without explicit drawn connecting edges. Edges are extracted strictly from visible green drawn arrows.
